title: FIR Filed Against Rahul Gandhi, Pappu Yadav Over Ram Temple Protest
summary: On [date], FIRs were filed against Rahul Gandhi and Pappu Yadav in Varanasi for their alleged role in a provocative performance at the Ram temple. The police received a complaint alleging that the protest was an affront to religious sentiments. The FIRs were filed after a complaint was lodged with the police, claiming that the protesters had violated the law by wearing saffron clothing and performing a provocative act. The police have started investigating the matter based on the complaint. Three MPs, including Rahul Gandhi, Pappu Yadav, and Avdesh Prasad, were named in the FIRs.
summary_points: FIRs filed against Rahul Gandhi and Pappu Yadav
Varanasi police received a complaint alleging affront to religious sentiments
Police started investigating based on the complaint
Three MPs named in the FIRs

framing.left: Left-leaning outlets framed the incident as a case of affront to religious sentiments, highlighting the complaint lodged with the police and the FIRs filed against Rahul Gandhi and Pappu Yadav. They emphasized the alleged violation of the law by wearing saffron clothing and performing a provocative act.
framing.center: Centrist coverage reported on the FIRs being filed against the MPs, but did not delve into the specific claims made in the complaint or the allegations of affront to religious sentiments.
framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focused on the alleged role of Rahul Gandhi and Pappu Yadav in the provocative performance, highlighting their involvement in the protest and the FIRs filed against them.
